KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

3. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

4. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

6. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato

7. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

8. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

9. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. fupi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
